# Version 4.148.0
> **First stable v4 release** · Released June 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.148.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.148.0)

> **Supersedes [4.147.0](4.147.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.148.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148. It rolls up the 4.147.x previews: variable font and color-font support, animated WebP encoding, a Vulkan/native-struct cleanup, and updated native dependencies. This is a breaking release from v3 - review the changes below before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **Default typeface resolution changed (empty vs. default vs. null)** — new SKFont() now stores an empty typeface (MeasureText returns 0) instead of lazily resolving a platform default; new SKPaint().Typeface now returns SKTypeface.Default instead of null; and SKTypeface.FromFamilyName("missing") now returns Default (never null) on every platform, including Android. Replace null checks with Typeface.IsEmpty, construct SKFont with an explicit typeface, or use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily for a strict null-on-miss check. ([#3735](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3735), [#3736](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3736), [#3737](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3737), [#3738](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3738))
- **SKStream.Move(long) now throws on overflow and is obsolete** — The previously-silent (int) truncation of large offsets is now a checked cast that throws OverflowException, and the overload is [Obsolete]. Call Move(int) with an in-range, pre-validated offset instead. ([#3740](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3740))
- **GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts the process on Vulkan 1.0** — Ganesh now requires Vulkan 1.1; instead of returning null on a 1.0 instance/device it calls SK_ABORT and terminates the process, which cannot be caught. Declare VK_API_VERSION_1_1 on both the VkApplicationInfo used to create the instance and on GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion (do not leave either at its default 0/1.0). ([#4600](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4600))
- **Vulkan interop structs changed shape** — GRVkBackendContextNative drops fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice - use fVkExtensions and fDeviceFeatures/fDeviceFeatures2 instead, and manage instance/device lifetime yourself. GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo gains a Components field and loses value-equality (Equals/==/!=); GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo is retyped to the new GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo. Also, SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose loses its public setter. ([#3741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3741))
- **Remaining pre-v4 obsolete APIs promoted to compile errors** — Legacy SKPaint text/font state-reading members and other pre-v4 obsolete APIs (and obsolete enum members trimmed from the ref assembly) now fail to build instead of warning. Migrate call sites onto SKFont per the v3 deprecation guidance before upgrading. ([#4068](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4068), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114), [#4205](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4205))

## Engine

- **Updated through Skia milestones 132 to 148** — Rolls the bundled engine forward across the 4.147.x preview line to Chrome milestone m148, plus multiple rounds of merged upstream bug fixes. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#4054](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4054), [#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125), [#4081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4081), [#4044](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4044))

## API Surface

- **Variable and color fonts** — Adds variable font support across SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp, color font palette support, and an HBColor struct for hb_color_t, plus assorted missing API wrappers and naming fixes. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742), [#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000), [#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))
- **Animated WebP encoding and zero-copy streams** — Adds SKWebpEncoder support for animated WebP output and SKStream.GetData() for zero-copy stream-to-data conversion. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771), [#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **SKSamplingOptions on surface drawing** — SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface now accept SKSamplingOptions. ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491))

## Bug Fixes

- **Pixel-access stride and offset fixes** — SKPixmap/SKBitmap.GetPixelSpan now use RowBytes for stride, and the generic GetPixelSpan<T>(x,y) offset uses Height instead of Width. ([#4148](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4148), [#4128](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4128))
- **SKPath finalizer crash fixed** — Fixes a crash when an SKPathBuilder is garbage-collected before the SKPath it built. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796))
- **WinUI and MAUI fixes** — Fixes the WinUI Projection DLL not being found for .NET 9 consumers, and SKGLView not rendering after a tab switch in a MAUI TabBar. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#4084](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4084), [#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Singleton lifecycle reworked** — Reworks how singleton instances are created and torn down, and moves the native-compatibility gate from a module initializer to the SkiaApi static constructor for more predictable startup. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080), [#4133](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4133))

## Platform

- **New native asset targets** — Adds Linux Bionic native asset support and Tizen x64/arm64 native builds, and fixes Apple platform TFMs to use 26.0 for libraries and unversioned TFMs for apps. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620), [#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798))
- **PolySharp for legacy TFM support** — Uses PolySharp to bring C# 13 language features to legacy target frameworks. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3642](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3642))

## Security

- **Bundled native dependencies refreshed** — Updates expat, harfbuzz, libjpeg-turbo, freetype, zlib, libpng, and libexpat to their latest patched versions. ([#4079](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4079), [#4035](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4035), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718), [#3717](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3717))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0

Adds the HBColor struct for hb_color_t, brings variable font support to HarfBuzzSharp, and updates the bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.0.
